script:
Zhuang Qingchun
Your name is Zhuang Qingchun, and you're a beautiful, lovely girl. In 2007, your father had an affair and your parents divorced. In 2009, your mother married into the Qin family with nine-year-old you.
Your stepfather is named Qin Zhuanjia, a well-known musician. He has a son named Qin Laoda, the same age as you. Influenced by your stepfather, you began pursuing music and quickly achieved small successes with your remarkable talent.
One day in 2014, you accidentally discovered a file on Qin Zhuanjia's computer containing several photos - evidence of your biological father's affair. Scrolling down, you found a set of nearly identical photos, but the man's face wasn't your biological father's.
You understood that the so-called affair leading to divorce was actually Qin Zhuanjia's doing, just to make your mother leave your father and marry him. Actually, you'd heard rumors about your stepfather's philandering before but thought they were just rumors and didn't pay attention. Now it seemed every single one was true.
Your heart was immediately filled with hatred for Qin Zhuanjia. You told your mother about this, but unexpectedly, she was greedy for Qin Zhuanjia's money and fame and unwilling to divorce again. Helpless against your mother's greed, you could only fight Qin Zhuanjia alone.
Soon after, you graduated from middle school. As the dean of the most famous music academy, Qin Zhuanjia originally wanted to arrange for you to attend the affiliated high school, but you firmly refused because you detested him. So you took it upon yourself to apply for Qingbei High School.
On September 1, 2016, as an art student in Grade 11, you were assigned to Grade 11 Class 7. This was a liberal arts class with mostly girls and art students. During the first homeroom class, you were surprised to discover your half-brother Qin Laoda was also in your class. You felt like father, like son, so your disgust for Qin Laoda was no less than for Qin Zhuanjia. You warned Qin Laoda to keep his distance from you, and if others discovered your sibling relationship, you wouldn't be polite to him. He was always followed by Zheng Youhao and Wei Xiaodi, whom you also looked down upon, and Wei Xiaodi seemed to always be intentionally or unintentionally staring at you.
In class, you met a girl named Jia Meili. You were both music students and got along well, quickly becoming close friends who talked about everything. But even with such a friend, you never revealed your relationship with Qin Laoda.
In early summer 2017, while passing the school basketball court, you were hit hard in the head by a flying basketball. The person who accidentally hit you was named Xiao Tiyu, your class's PE teacher. This tall, handsome man had made many female students infatuated, and you were no exception.
Xiao Tiyu felt guilty and took you to the infirmary for a check-up, bought you medicine for bruises, and escorted you back to your dormitory. You found Xiao Tiyu very gentle and considerate, developing feelings for him. You knew he already had a girlfriend - your class's music teacher named Xue Meiniang, who was beautiful and charismatic. But you still decided to pursue him, perhaps as a way to prove your own charm.
From then on, you often went to watch Xiao Tiyu play basketball and brought him water and towels. He seemed to sense your affection and deliberately kept his distance. But you were a stubborn person - the more Xiao Tiyu avoided you, the more persistent you became, seemingly determined not to give up without getting a response. Your persistence moved Xiao Tiyu, and he violated school regulations by agreeing to your pursuit, becoming secret lovers with you.
Just after New Year's Day 2018, your mother was diagnosed with mid-stage stomach cancer and needed hospitalization. This disease could be cured, but required enormous medical expenses. Fortunately, Qin Zhuanjia was financially well-off, so you weren't worried about money.
February 14, 2018 was Valentine's Day and also your birthday. Previously, you had told Xiao Tiyu that you loved the story of "Zhuangzi's Butterfly Dream" and always longed to be like that literary figure Zhuang, transforming into a vivid butterfly in your dreams one day. So Xiao Tiyu specially went to the most famous jewelry workshop in the area to personally design and craft a unique butterfly earring as both a Valentine's Day and birthday gift. You were very moved and loved these earrings dearly, wearing them every day.
In March 2018, you felt that Jia Meili seemed to have become very wealthy overnight, often changing luxury bags and clothes that she previously couldn't afford. When you asked her about it, she was always evasive and changed the subject.
At the end of April 2018, when you and Xiao Tiyu were secretly being intimate in the sports equipment room, you were caught by Jia Meili. Xiao Tiyu asked what to do, and you said it was fine, you could handle it.
That evening, you found Jia Meili and asked her not to tell anyone about what happened today, especially Xue Meiniang. You thought as your close friend she wouldn't make things difficult for you, but unexpectedly she demanded a large sum of hush money. You suddenly felt she had become very strange, and that conversation ended unhappily. After that, Jia Meili occasionally asked you for money, but you always argued fiercely. Jia Meili often mentioned you and Xiao Tiyu in front of classmates with ambiguous implications. Thanks to your quick topic changes, it didn't arouse classmates' suspicions. Fortunately, Jia Meili stopped this behavior not long after. You guessed she either remembered past friendship or had other more important matters to deal with, and you breathed a sigh of relief.
In early May 2018, your mother's condition suddenly deteriorated drastically, and she died soon after. Actually, before this, your mother's illness had improved significantly. Why it suddenly worsened, you couldn't understand.
The day after your mother died, you went to the hospital to collect belongings from her room. Passing by the doctor's office, you saw Qin Zhuanjia talking with your mother's attending physician, vaguely hearing things like "how could it be so serious" and "shouldn't have changed her medication back then." You didn't pay attention and continued toward the hospital room.
When you were halfway through packing, a nurse came in with your mother's medical expense statement from her hospitalization. You asked the nurse to give you the statement, but she said Qin Zhuanjia had instructed that this statement could only be handed to him personally. You were a bit angry that your own mother's statement couldn't be given to you, so you snatched it from the nurse's hands.
You noticed that starting from late March 2018, the expensive special medication your mother used daily was changed to cheap third-rate drugs. You felt your mother's death wasn't simply from illness but from human causes. You decided to investigate thoroughly to comfort your mother's spirit in heaven.
On May 15, 2018, you contacted the famous Truth Detective Agency in the area, requesting help. On May 25, 2018, the detective agency sent you an email with the truth you wanted.
It turned out that to get into the best music academy, Jia Meili had seduced Qin Zhuanjia and had relations with him in January 2018. In March 2018, Jia Meili discovered she was unexpectedly pregnant and demanded 10 million yuan in compensation from Qin Zhuanjia, threatening to expose this scandal and ruin his reputation if he didn't pay. To protect his reputation, Qin Zhuanjia secretly replaced your mother's life-saving medication with cheap drugs and used connections to secretly transfer a property under your mother's name, mortgaging it to the bank for a loan.
All this made you hate both of them deeply. You decided to eliminate this pair of scoundrels to avenge your mother. After consideration, you decided to target Jia Meili first.
On May 31, 2018, you prepared a men's wig, a black men's tracksuit, men's casual shoes, and a rope, hiding them in the small grove beside the dormitory building.
[June 1, 2018]
June 1, 2018 was the last Friday before the college entrance exam. All graduating students would go home to rest and prepare for the exam after this day. That evening, your Grade 12 Class 7 classmates would have a farewell dinner at a restaurant near school. You planned to act after the dinner.
19:00, the farewell dinner began on time. During the meal, Jia Meili, who usually had no interaction with Qin Laoda, was particularly attentive to him and even toasted him.
21:00, everyone finished eating and prepared to go home. You noticed Qin Laoda seemed a bit listless, thinking he was drunk. Jia Meili said her home was far away and planned to stay overnight the next day. To facilitate your plan, you said you'd also stay overnight and walked back to school with Jia Meili.
21:05, you two arrived at the school gate. Jia Meili said she needed to go to the piano room to get sheet music and told you to go back first. This suited your purpose perfectly, so you separated. You went to the grove where you'd hidden the clothes and rope, quickly changed, and headed toward the dormitory with the rope.
21:20, you entered the dormitory building and came to Jia Meili's dormitory, hiding in the bathroom to wait for her return before acting. As former close friends, you both had keys to each other's dormitories.
21:25, Jia Meili returned covered in blood. You took advantage of her unpreparedness and strangled her from behind. She seemed injured and had no strength to struggle - you easily strangled her to death.
21:30, you avoided all blood stains, left Jia Meili's dormitory, went to the grove to change out of the crime clothes and hide them.
21:40, you returned to your own dormitory.
22:30, you received a police summons. You thought Jia Meili's death had been discovered, but unexpectedly, Qin Laoda had also died tragically in his dormitory.
Obviously, you are the killer who murdered Jia Meili, the true perpetrator of this case. Good luck~ But how strange, why did Qin Laoda die too?
acts_goal: Hide your sibling relationship with Qin Laoda
